test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six brothers Aman, Bunty, Chandu, Deepak, Emad and Faisal, each has a different height. Bunty is taller than only three brothers. Faisal is only taller than Deepak. Chandu is shorter than Aman only. Who is the fourth tallest among the brothers?
solution:
As per the given information:

1. Bunty is taller than only three brothers.

_ > _ > Bunty > _ > _ > _

2. Faisal is only taller than Deepak.

_ > _ > Bunty > _ > Faisal > Deepak

3. Chandu is shorter than Aman only.

Aman > Chandu > Bunty > _ > Faisal > Deepak

4. The remaining brother Emad is taller than Faisal and shorter than Bunty.

Aman > Chandu > Bunty > Emad > Faisal > Deepak

Here,** '**Emad**' **is the fourth tallest.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

From the arrangement we got- 

Aman > Chandu > Bunty > Emad > Faisal > Deepak

Aman is the tallest, Chandu is the 2nd tallest, Bunty is the 3rd tallest and Emad is the 4th tallest.
